Is responsible in your work performance

jobs.occupation: Teacher of English - IB programmes
jobs.description:
Would you like to inspire young people in their learning and development in a unique and international school environment? This is a role where you will have an opportunity to influence your students’ language development and contribute to their future.

At Sigtunaskolan Humanistiska Läroverket you will become part of a unique school environment, where young people from all over the world study and develop together. Here, the work is not only about teaching, but also building rapport, creating commitment and sparking curiosity for language and culture. As a teacher, you are close to the students in their everyday life where you contribute to their academic development as well as their personal growth.

SSHL is a boarding school, with roots from the 1920s, which today has about 550 students from over 30 different countries. We offer Swedish and international education, including the Swedish high school and the IB programmes. Our ambition is to continuously work with our students’ best interests in mind.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
About the Role

We are now looking for a certified teacher of English for a substitute position during the spring term of 2027. The parental leave substitute position covers 70% teaching in our IB Programmes. The requirements for this position involve teaching in English and you will be working closely with students, colleagues and the school management in a dynamic and international environment.  

In your role as a teacher you will be responsible for the planning, implementation and follow-up of your teaching. You will also actively work to develop your teaching in collaboration with colleagues and contribute to a stimulating learning environment.

KVALIFIKATIONER
We are looking for someone who:

	• is a certified teacher in English with experience of International Baccalaureate programmes
	• can easily build a trusting rapport with young people and colleagues
	• is organised and flexible with good planning skills
	• has a solution-oriented approach and good judgment
	• is genuinely interested in teaching and student development
	• enjoys working in an international and dynamic environment

Qualifications:

	• teaching certificate for English or equivalent qualifications
	• experience in teaching in the IB Diploma and Middle years Programme
	• very good communication skills in English and Swedish are desirable
	• experience of an international environment is advantageous

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

We are offering

A meaningful role in an international environment, where you will have an opportunity to influence students learning and development, while becoming a member of a committed and supportive team of colleagues

Your personal suitability for this position will be of great importance and before employment an approved extract from the criminal record is required. During the application period interviews will continuously take place.

The application deadline is November 30th 2026 and the start date will be January 7th 2027.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact:

Kerry Browning, Principal, +46 8-592 571 00, kerry.browning@sshl.se or 

Alexandra Koumi, Vice principal, alexandra.koumi@sshl.se

jobs.description:
Engagerad lärare i engelska och NO 4-6 eller teknik 7-9 sökes till Internationella Engelska Skolan Karlstad.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Karlstad är en skola för årskurs 4-9 med 400 elever och 50 anställda. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska, beroende på ämne. Hos oss sätts lärande och kunskap i första rummet. Vi är en skola med en stark och tydlig värdegrund som präglas av en trygg arbetsmiljö, god ordning och mycket omtanke. Vårt mål är att eleverna ska lära sig ta ett personligt ansvar för sin utveckling och sin arbetsmiljö, samt respektera sina skolkamrater, sina lärare och sig själva.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med start 2027-01-07. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna enligt gällande kollektivavtal.

Vi söker i första hand dig som har adekvat högskoleutbildning och svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i engelska och NO-ämnena eller teknik för de aktuella årskurserna. 

Din profil

- Du har svenska eller engelska som modersmål, samt goda kunskaper i båda språken för att kunna verka i vår tvåspråkiga miljö.
- Du har förmågan att utöva ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap i klassrummet.
- Du är en aktiv normsättare som kan upprätthålla den trygghet och studiero som vår skola står för. 

För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara kreativ, ansvarstagande och nytänkande. Du drivs av att ha en nära och regelbunden kontakt med vårdnadshavare. Vidare är du en lagspelare som uppskattar att samarbeta med kollegor i en stödjande och professionell miljö.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet och hur väl din pedagogiska profil matchar skolans värdegrund och arbetssätt. Ett aktuellt utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister är ett lagstadgat krav för anställning i skolan och måste uppvisas innan ett eventuellt erbjudande om anställning kan ges.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. För mer information om vår skola, se www.karlstad.engelska.se Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev, lärarlegitimation samt utdrag från polisregistret till applications.karlstad@engelska.se

Märk ansökningen “Lärare i engelska och NO/teknik”.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in English with a Specialisation in Literature
jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.
 
 
Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?
 
 
Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.
 
 
The Faculty of Philosophy, conducts education and research in the humanities, social sciences and education, mathematics and natural sciences, as well as the arts. Our research and education are carried out in close dialogue with the wider community and contribute to critical knowledge development, intellectual growth, and a deeper understanding of complex societal issues. Education is offered at all levels and is grounded in scientific or artistic foundations and characterized by academic breadth. Together, we contribute to a sustainable, open, and knowledge-based society.  The Faculty comprises three departments, employing approximately 420 members of staff in total. Through our collaborative platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector, and industry to jointly advance knowledge development and address societal challenges.
 
 
The Department of Social Science and Humanities provides education in social sciences, behavioural sciences, and language and communication. Research focuses on societal issues such as democracy, migration, sustainable development and communication, and is conducted in close collaboration with the surrounding society.
Employment information
Employment: Permanent employment which begins with possible trial employment
 
Period of employment/Start date: 2027-08-01
 
Scope: Part-time 75 %
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-02
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
Department/Unit: Social Sciences and Humanities
For information and a detailed description of basic eligibility requirements and assessment criteria, that apply to a position of a senior lecturer, please consult the Appointment Regulations for Mälardalen University https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities
Position description
As a senior lecturer at MDU, your main tasks are teaching. Teaching also includes supervision, examination, course evaluation and course development. At MDU, research and education are closely intertwined and research forms the basis of our programmes. Collaboration is also an integral part of our research and education mission and as a senior lecturer you will actively contribute to the university's development work.

jobs.occupation: 1st Line Support Agent (English and Spanish speaking)
jobs.description:
The company has developed a groundbreaking cloud service for transportation companies. They have customers all over the world.
They are experiencing strong demand of their product and because of that they need to strengthen their 1st line support team with a Spanish and English speaking support agent.
This position is in Linköping and you need to work from the office.

About you
● You have excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think “outside the box”.
● You possess great computing skills and are interested in all things technical.
● You provide a high level of customer service and have a full understanding of its importance.
● You are a curious and fast learner.
● You communicate clearly in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.

This is considered an entry-level position and although we don’t believe that you need specific qualifications to succeed in this role, it is very important that you are interested in tech, and have a basic understanding of computing, cloud-based services, and mobile technology.

About the position 
As a 1st line support agent, no two days will look the same.
Your daily focus will be to help our customers through phone, web chat and email.
You will help our customers solving their problems and making sure they have the correct settings on their account.
Over time, you will become an expert in the system and point of contact for anyone internally, you’ll be providing operational and technical support to teams across all of our departments.
The working hours will be normal office hours, Monday to Friday.

Your daily tasks will include
● Help the customers through phone, web chat and email, to make sure the customers can use the system the way they want it to work.
● Supporting the sales teams in sales demos and general technical support.

It will be considered an advantage if
● You speak additional languages, especially Swedish, Finnish, or French.
● You have experience in technical support, ideally in an international environment.

For this position you need to already have a Swedish work permit.
